credit-scorecard.description: Weight-of-Evidence logistic-regression scorecard for consumer credit. FastWoe encodes each feature to its WOE (numerics monotone tree-binned, categoricals target-encoded), then logistic regression scores the vector. The monotone binning carries the bank's directional business rules by construction.
credit-scorecard.risk_rationale: The model contributes to consumer credit decisions; errors affect access to credit and portfolio loss.
credit-scorecard.intended_use: Score consumer credit applications for the probability of default, as one input to an underwriting decision.
credit-scorecard.out_of_scope: Not for automated adverse action without human review, and not validated outside the consumer-credit population it was trained on.
credit-scorecard.dataset: Synthetic credit-bureau applications (chapter 2), no real names or PII
credit-scorecard.metrics_source: Held-out validation set, chapter 2 training run

credit-challenger.description: Monotone gradient-boosted challenger for consumer credit. XGBoost with monotonic constraints so the model honours the same directional business rules as the incumbent scorecard, while capturing interactions the linear model cannot.
credit-challenger.risk_rationale: The model contributes to consumer credit decisions; errors affect access to credit and portfolio loss.
credit-challenger.intended_use: Candidate replacement for the incumbent scorecard, evaluated against it under a controlled rollout before any promotion.
credit-challenger.out_of_scope: Not for automated adverse action without human review, and not validated outside the consumer-credit population it was trained on.
credit-challenger.dataset: Synthetic credit-bureau applications (chapter 2), no real names or PII
credit-challenger.metrics_source: Held-out validation set, chapter 2 training run
